question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched position, secured through the 2018 removal of presidential term limits, loyalist placements across the Politburo and military, and the absence of succession signals ahead of the 2027 Party Congress, drives the 95.5% trader consensus against an early exit. Centralized party control and the opaque elite selection process have historically favored continuity for sitting leaders, with no verified internal challenges or policy reversals emerging in recent months to alter this trajectory. While sudden health events or elite fractures from economic pressures could theoretically prompt change, such outcomes lack precedent in the current institutional framework and remain low-probability variables in market assessments.
